info.name: TIBCO Spotfire Analytics Library API
info.description:
Analytics and data visualization REST API for TIBCO Spotfire Server. Provides programmatic access to manage analysis files, library items, data sources, users, groups, and scheduled tasks for embedded analytics and automated reporting workflows.

Contact Support:
 Name: TIBCO Support
